professionalSummary.text: Maintains an integrated project plan and RAID log for a finance or regulatory change project.
professionalSummary.witness: Kept the integrated plan and RAID log for moving Marlow Mutual Insurance's quarterly solvency returns from spreadsheets to a vendor reporting platform, from mobilisation in March 2022 to closure in August 2023.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepares steering committee packs and records decisions and actions.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the monthly steering committee pack (status, milestones, top risks, decisions needed) and issued minutes with numbered actions after each meeting.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Coordinates user acceptance testing with finance users and tracks defects to closure.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Coordinated three rounds of user acceptance testing with the finance reporting team, triaging 212 defects in the test management tool and chairing the daily defect call during each round.

skills.text: Reports realised benefits measured against the baseline in the approved business case.
skills.witness: Organised the parallel run for the Q2 2023 return, reconciling the platform output against the spreadsheet output line by line with the actuarial team.
